input.answer: The processor must notify the controller of any personal data breach within 48 hours.

sources.text: Personal data is processed solely for the purpose of delivering the service. Data is stored within the European Economic Area.

cases.rationale: The source is on the same topic and does not state the notification deadline. This must not become a contradiction. It is the key false-accusation control.

input.answer: All customers receive a refund within 30 days of cancelling.

sources.text: One customer received a refund within 30 days of cancelling in March.

cases.rationale: A universal claim is neither supported nor refuted by a single instance.
